title: ‘BTS Recipe Book’: K-Pop Superstars Break Down Their Favorite Korean Dishes in a New Cookbook
summary: Available for preorder, BTS Recipe Book is a must for BTS ARMYs — releases on Tuesday (Sept. 15).
contentText:

During the annual BTS ARMY festival, BTS Festa, in June, Hachette Book Group’s Running Press announced a new cookbook in partnership with the K-pop superstars — including RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook.

On sale for $21 (regularly $30) on Amazon, BTS Recipe Book gets its inspiration from the supergroup’s album eras with recipes for Korean cuisine, such as braised beef ribs, carp bread, ginseng chicken soup, Korean fried chicken, rice crackers, simmered rice cakes, sugar-filled griddlecakes and other dishes, per Rolling Stone . In fact, some of the recipes appeared in the series, RUN BTS! , BTS: Bon Voyage and In the Soop .

The cookbook, which is available for preorder with release on Tuesday (Sept. 15), is best for those who want to experience the group’s favorite dishes.

BTS Recipe Book is also available as a Kindle ebook . It’s less expensive than the physical hardcover book, as it’s priced at $14.99. The ebook version also comes out on Tuesday (Sept. 15). If you preorder now, it will be delivered digitally to your Kindle or Kindle mobile app upon release.

Meanwhile, the cookbook comes with digital codes for fans to get more out of the cooking with BTS experience, including exclusive videos, tips for creating Korean cuisine, food commentary from members of the supergroup and other features.

Available for preorder, BTS Recipe Book by BTS is on sale for $21 (regularly $30) on Amazon. It drops on Tuesday (Sept. 15).

Additionally, the cookbook is available for preorder at BookShop.org for $27.96 (regularly $30) , while BTS Recipe Book can be preordered at Barnes & Noble priced at $30 .
